description:
Sub-50 10K means 5:00/km on average, but running it evenly is not the only way to get there.

Start a little slower (5:05/km for three kilometres), lock into 4:59/km through km 8, then finish at 4:52/km. You cross the line in 49:54 with the hard part saved for when it counts.

Check your watch at 3, 5 and 8 km: being 10 to 15 seconds behind even pace is part of the plan.

Save it for race day.

#sub5010k #10ktraining #negativesplit #racepacing #10krace
